gate: Power, here, means raw life force taking form as action. A person carrying this code feels it as engine, the body wanting to move, do, push something into the world. It is not power as dominance or volume. It is the simple fact of vitality available, fuel for whatever the body has actually said yes to. The misread is that this gate is about being strong or in charge. It is not. Strength shows up only when the action has the body's real yes underneath it. Without that, the same energy turns busy and dissipates, the person running hard on nothing and burning out. This code is the busiest gate in the chart, and that is the warning as much as the gift. Used in alignment, it is sustainable and almost clean. Used to chase what was never really wanted, it grinds the body down and leaves the person feeling powerless inside their own force.
centre_field: The sacral is the body's motor, the deepest source of usable life-force in the design. It is the centre of vitality, sexuality, work, and the gut yes or no that knows before the mind catches up. Placing the power gate here is the whole teaching. Power, in this code, is not a quality of personality. It is wired directly to the engine of the body itself, so it only runs clean when the engine has been asked and the engine has answered. The sacral responds, it does not initiate from the head. So this gate carries force, but the force has a condition: it waits for something real to push against. When that condition is honored, the energy is sustainable, almost bottomless. When the head overrides the gut and tells the body what to do, the same motor still runs, but it runs hot and empties out fast.
channel: Most gates form a single circuit with one partner. This one is different. It reaches into three other codes at once, toward behavior of the self, toward the now, toward intuition, and the cluster of four gates these connections form is called the Integration channels, a small web at the centre of the body-map where the sacral motor meets identity, the throat, and the spleen. The reach into behavior of the self turns the power into the energy of self-discovery and authentic action. The reach into the now turns it into charisma, voice with engine behind it. The reach into intuition turns it into the instinctive, immediate response of the body. Alone, this code is force with nowhere to go. Joined into any of the three, it becomes a specific kind of power. Joined into all three at once, it sits at the heart of an unusually woven body.
